item.title: The Appeal of Dark Themes
item.description:
Dark themes have become increasingly popular in recent years, and for good reason. They offer several benefits:

Reduced Eye Strain: Dark backgrounds reduce the amount of light emitted by screens, which can help reduce eye strain, especially in low-light environments.

Better for Night Reading: Many people find dark themes more comfortable when reading or coding late at night.

Battery Life: On OLED displays, dark themes can actually save battery life since black pixels are turned off.
